expectations.text: The agent located frmReceipt from the visible strings (find_screen.py or equivalent), stated it as the match, and did not ask the user which form it is
expectations.evidence: Matched all 9 strings to frmReceipt; stated it; did not ask

expectations.text: A unit file named exactly after the unit ID (e.g. SCR-<MODULE>-<Name>.md, ASCII) exists under modules/<MODULE>/units/ and the unit is registered in STATE.json with sources and aliases (frmReceipt, 'PHIẾU THU TIỀN')
expectations.evidence: modules/REC/units/SCR-REC-Receipt.md; STATE aliases ['PHIẾU THU TIỀN','frmReceipt']; sources registered (only frmReceipt.cs, Designer file missing, see analysis)

expectations.text: Requirement IDs follow REQ-<MODULE>-<ShortName>-<nnn> with 3 digits and are not reused or duplicated
expectations.evidence: IDs REQ-REC-Receipt-001..008, 3-digit, no duplicates; counters match

expectations.text: There are separate FN entries for total, payable and change with the exact formulas: total = sum(Qty x Price); payable = total - discount; change = tendered - payable
expectations.evidence: FN-REC-001..003 with Sum(Qty x Price), total-discount, tendered-payable

expectations.text: Each FN has at least 3 test vectors with an edge case, one of them consistent with: lines 2x100,000 and 1x50,000, discount 20,000, tendered 250,000 -> total 250,000, payable 230,000, change 20,000
expectations.evidence: Each FN has 3 vectors incl. edge (e.g. 100,000 total, 150,000 discount -> -50,000) but none is the 250,000/230,000/20,000 case; assertion is over-specified

expectations.text: The spec records that unparsable or empty discount/tendered text is treated as 0 (Parse returns 0)
expectations.evidence: IMP-REC-003 evidence: Parse returns 0 on bad input (cs:20-24)

expectations.text: Save validation order is recorded exactly: patient required, then at least one line, then stock check only for lines of type Drug
expectations.evidence: REQ states checks run in order: patient, lines, Drug stock

expectations.text: The Messages section lists all four messages: 'Vui lòng chọn bệnh nhân', 'Không có dịch vụ để thu', 'Không đủ tồn kho: <code>', 'Đã lưu phiếu thu' with their trigger conditions
expectations.evidence: All four messages present with trigger conditions (counts 2/2/3/2)
